classification.entry_condition: bending compliant with valid optimisation opportunity outside efficiency target band
governs_when: current bending design lies outside efficiency target band
must_not_govern_when: combined bending and shear underdesign governs

internal_strategy_ladder.entry_condition: bending compliant with valid optimisation opportunity outside efficiency target band

lanes.title: Reduce bottom reinforcement
lanes.purpose: Search progressively lighter bottom reinforcement while preserving bending compliance and As >= As_min.

lanes.title: Reduce reinforcement layers
lanes.purpose: Prefer simpler single-layer reinforcement where code compliance permits.

lanes.title: Reduce beam width
lanes.purpose: Reduce width in bounded increments where bending, geometry, proportion, and constructability constraints remain satisfied.

lanes.title: Reduce beam depth
lanes.purpose: Reduce depth in bounded increments where bending, geometry, proportion, and constructability constraints remain satisfied.

lanes.title: Exact stop
lanes.purpose: Stop only when the selected or current optimisation result is inside target band and no higher-ranked candidate exists.

lanes.title: Exhausted
lanes.purpose: Prove all legal bending optimisation branches were attempted or blocked with specific blocker evidence.

global_family_rules: candidates with As < As_min are discarded before ranking
minimum reinforcement boundary takes precedence over optimisation objective
when minimum reinforcement or ductility controls the overdesign cleanup boundary, bottom reinforcement reduction must be attempted before geometry relief
when minimum reinforcement controls the overdesign cleanup boundary, width reduction must be checked as an As_min relief path before exact stop or exhausted
when minimum reinforcement controls the overdesign cleanup boundary, valid depth reduction must also be checked as an As_min relief path before exact stop or exhausted
geometry reductions must preserve bending compliance, geometry constraints, beam proportion limits, and constructability
every geometry reduction restarts bottom reinforcement and layer optimisation
shared CTA/publication/apply/UI/session/source-precedence layers remain outside the family

discard_before_ranking_when: next optimisation candidate would produce As < As_min
valid_blockers: next candidate would produce As < As_min
As_min remains governing after width-reduction and valid depth-reduction geometry relief search
width reduction cannot lower As_min enough to permit a lighter compliant reinforcement arrangement
depth reduction cannot lower As_min enough or improve the cleanup path enough to permit a lighter compliant reinforcement arrangement
current reinforcement arrangement is the lightest compliant arrangement available
specific_blocker_evidence_required: Further reinforcement reduction would violate minimum reinforcement requirements.
Minimum bending reinforcement / Ast-min boundary identified.
Bottom reinforcement reduction was attempted first for ductility / ku cleanup.
Width-reduction geometry relief was checked before accepting the As_min blocker.
Valid depth-reduction geometry relief was checked before accepting the As_min blocker.
Bottom reinforcement and layer search restarted after each valid geometry-relief step.
Current reinforcement arrangement is the lightest compliant arrangement available.

required_when: bottom reinforcement reduction is blocked only by As_min
ductility / ku cleanup cannot improve further without lighter bottom reinforcement
current bending utilisation is below accepted cleanup floor
must_evaluate: width reduction plus restarted bottom reinforcement candidates
width reduction plus restarted layer reduction candidates
depth reduction plus restarted bottom reinforcement candidates
depth reduction plus restarted layer reduction candidates
exhausted_only_when: no width reduction plus lighter reinforcement candidate keeps all required checks passing
no valid depth reduction plus lighter reinforcement candidate keeps all required checks passing
no legal width reduction can reduce As_min enough to permit lighter reinforcement
no legal depth reduction can reduce As_min enough or improve the cleanup path enough to permit lighter reinforcement
specific Ast-min blocker evidence is published

requires: when minimum reinforcement governs, width reduction is evaluated as an As_min relief path and restarts bottom reinforcement search
when minimum reinforcement governs, valid depth reduction is evaluated as an As_min relief path and restarts bottom reinforcement search

restarted_candidate_requirements: width plus restarted bottom reinforcement candidate
width plus restarted layer reduction candidate
depth plus restarted bottom reinforcement candidate
depth plus restarted layer reduction candidate

case_e.expected: candidate never appears in ranked recommendations

exact_stop_allowed_when: reo reduction was attempted first for ductility / ku cleanup
As_min geometry relief by width and valid depth reduction was attempted where geometry is unlocked
bottom reinforcement and layer search restarted after each valid geometry-relief step
exhausted_requires: every valid cleanup path is exhausted for contract-defined reasons
